conviction_note: New, not pre-released numbers on a thin two-analyst name whose own print reactions run -28.5/-12.7/-16.7/+3.2/+5.1/+5.9% put abs_move at 9%, but the evidence on the sign is all proxy and offsets (largest customer CMP and Chinese newbuild completions strong, USD/SEK a ~4% tailwind, against a record Q2 that likely contained catch-up/restocking from the recovering second customer and a run-up into the print), so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0; the findings sum to 0.0 by genuine offset, not by fitting.

already_public.what: Q2 2026: net sales SEK 58.7m (+86%), EBIT SEK 21.4m (36% margin), H1 sales 111.4m; CEO: strong H1 a solid foundation for the rest of 2026; no numeric guidance given (the company does not guide)

EU approval of Selektope (medetomidine) extended to 31 Dec 2026; Commission draft act proposes non-renewal; WTO-TBT consultation from early July; SCBP vote no earlier than end-September, more likely Q4; legal challenge prepared

Exclusive worldwide aquaculture licence with Titanium Technology S.L. (early stage, no financial terms), released 09:30 CEST the day before the print, so inside the 2026-10-15 close that starts the window
No profit warning (vinstvarning) or trading update for Q3 on the Nasdaq Nordic feed; the only I-Tech releases since the Q2 report are the 2026-10-15 licence and nothing else

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales and EBIT are entirely new. Easy comp (Q3 2025 SEK 41.0m, EBIT 11.1m, hit by the second-largest customer's financial constraints) and a ~4% USD/SEK tailwind point to strong y/y growth; whether it holds near Q2's record 58.7m or normalises toward ~45-50m after Q2 catch-up is unknown. Slight lean above the (unsourced) bar.

Regulatory update on the SCBP vote on medetomidine non-renewal (timing, expected outcome, legal-challenge readiness). Non-renewal is the expected case per ABG; a firm December vote date or tone change is the likely content. Sign unknown, small.
CEO commentary on Q4 / customer order cadence and raw-material costs (Hormuz-related); unknown.
Working capital after Q2's strong 23.6m operating cash flow; unknown.
none: the company does not issue numeric guidance

bar: unsourced as a number: no Q3 2026 consensus was found. ABG (one of two analysts) raised '26e-'28e sales +5% and EBIT adj. +15% after Q2 (https://www.inderes.se/en/third-party-research/i-tech-strongest-quarter-on-record-abg, 2026-08-21) on top of a '26e organic growth assumption of +25% (https://www.inderes.se/en/third-party-research/i-tech-2026-looking-better-than-feared-abg, 2026-05-08); arithmetic on FY2025 sales of ~168m implies a Q3e of roughly SEK 46-52m, which is my inference, not a published estimate. Every finding is capped small.
session_check: bmo: the issuer's MFN calendar lists 'Kvartalsrapport 2026-Q3' at 2026-10-16 08:00 (https://mfn.se/all/a/i-tech), the company's own calendar lists Interim report Q3 2026 on 16 October 2026 (https://www.i-tech.se/investors/financial-calendar/), and every prior I-Tech report on the Nasdaq Nordic feed went out at 08:00 CET/CEST, before the 09:00 open.
positioning_check: Finansinspektionen aggregate register read 2026-10-15 and does not name I-Tech (https://www.fi.se/sv/vara-register/blankningsregistret/GetBlankningsregisterAggregat/): a 0.5% truncation zero, anchor_covered false, so there is no positioning anchor and priced_lean_pct is essentially the run-up. No PDMR trades since the 2026-07-09 warrant subscriptions (FI insynsregister, https://marknadssok.fi.se/publiceringsklient/sv-SE/Search/Search?SearchFunctionType=Insyn&Utgivare=I-Tech). Tape: +2.3% on 2026-10-14 on 41.8k shares and +2.4% on 10-15 on 41.0k, about 2.5x the usual ~15k daily volume, i.e. buying into the print.

findings.finding: The largest customer (Chugoku Marine Paints, reported as >60% of sales; CMP organic growth +35% in H1) printed Apr-Jun recurring profit +56%, flagged as a surprise beat, and on 2026-07-03 set its FY guide on 'firm demand for marine and industrial coatings', and China's H1 2026 shipbuilding completions rose 51.2% y/y, so demand at the customer driving I-Tech's volume was strong going into Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales surprises drive this stock: Q2 2026 sales +21% vs ABGSCe -> +5.1%; Q1 2026 +27% vs ABGSCe -> +3.2%; Q3 2025 -18% vs ABGSCe -> -12.7%; Q2 2025 miss -> -28.5% (MFN day-reaction column, https://mfn.se/all/a/i-tech). Beats are rewarded far less than misses are punished.
findings.original_quote: 中国塗、4-6月期(1Q)経常は56％増益で着地 (CMP, Apr-Jun (Q1) recurring profit lands +56%); and Monex: 売上高は船舶用・工業用塗料の需要が堅調 (sales: demand for marine and industrial coatings is firm)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: CMP's quarter is public since July and fed I-Tech's Q2, which the stock rose 5% on. What is not priced is its read-through to Jul-Sep volumes, because CMP's own Jul-Sep results come only on 2026-10-30. If the market had fully extrapolated it, the stock would sit above its post-Q2 highs of 77-78 SEK rather than at 73.
findings.independence: China MIIT H1 2026 shipbuilding completions +51.2% y/y, orderbook +54.9% (https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202607/23/WS6a61526da310d709c2fbf263.html, 2026-07-23); I-Tech Q2 report itself gives CMP +35% organic H1 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b152c327344eab9443185a1d9bc571988&lang=en&src=listed)

findings.finding: USD/SEK averaged roughly 9.85 over Jul-Sep 2026 against about 9.45 in Jul-Sep 2025 and about 9.5 in Q2 2026, so the currency that cost Q1 -14% and Q2 -3% turns into a roughly +4% translation tailwind on USD-invoiced sales in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FX has never been the line this stock traded on; Q1 2026's -14% FX headwind was absorbed by the volume beat (+3.2%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the rate is public and analysts mark FX, and USD/SEK had already moved to ~9.9 by the Aug 21 estimate revision. What is left is only a small surprise on volume-adjusted reported growth.
findings.independence: I-Tech Q2 report confirms USD exposure ('the USD/SEK exchange rate remained weaker ... revenue growth adjusted for currency effects amounted to 91 percent') https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b152c327344eab9443185a1d9bc571988&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Q2's record SEK 58.7m was driven partly by the recovery of the second-largest customer (91% organic growth YTD after cutting 2025 volumes by about two thirds) while the CEO had warned in Q1 of a raw-material shortage risk for antifouling coatings from the Hormuz disruption, so part of Q2 was probably catch-up or precautionary stocking that makes a Q3 below Q2, and possibly below an extrapolated bar, the likely shape of this lumpy order book.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Order-timing shortfalls have been this name's worst prints: Q2 2025 -28.5% and Q3 2025 -12.7% were both a customer reducing offtake; Q4 2025 -16.7% the same customer (https://mfn.se/all/a/i-tech).
findings.why_not_priced: It is an inference, not a disclosed number: the company never quantified restocking, and ABG raised estimates after Q2 rather than flagging pull-forward. If the market had priced a normalisation, the stock would not have been bought into the print on 2.5x volume on 10-14 and 10-15.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 CEO comment on Hormuz-related raw-material shortage risk, reported by Redeye/borsvarlden search snippet (https://borsvarlden.com/artiklar/i-tech-q3-initial-take-softer-figures-and-underlying-progress-redeye, snippet_only for the 2026 part); Affärsvärlden on the 2025 two-thirds volume cut (https://www.affarsvarlden.se/analys/i-tech-bottenkanning, snippet_only, host refuses fetch)

findings.finding: I-Tech signed an exclusive worldwide aquaculture licence for Titanium Technology's non-biocidal electrochemical antifouling on 2026-10-15, explicitly 'an early-stage development programme' with no financial terms, released the day before the print and therefore already in the close that starts the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-19 biologically derived antifouling rights acquisition moved +1.6% on SEK 1.4m (https://mfn.se/all/a/i-tech); portfolio deals have been non-events.
findings.original_quote: Samtidigt befinner sig projektet i ett tidigt utvecklingsskede (At the same time the project is at an early stage of development) -- the English release: 'this is an early-stage development programme'
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: released 09:30 CEST on 10-15 and inside that day's close. Filed only so the report's likely discussion of it is not double-counted elsewhere.

findings.finding: The stock rose 2.3% on 2026-10-14 (before any news) and 2.4% on 10-15 on about 41k shares a day, roughly 2.5x its usual volume, lifting the 5-day run-up to +6.3% into the print, which raises the bar for a stock whose beats have been rewarded with +3-6% and whose misses with -13 to -28%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after +12% L3M and still rose 5.1% on a 21% sales beat; no clean history of run-ups into prints otherwise.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself; filed as the raised bar rather than as a signal. It is also the free control, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Opex carries a known drag in Q3: the company says the BPR re-registration 'continues to generate substantial costs', currently legal-appeal preparation, plus the EOGRT study ABG costs at about SEK 10m split over '26e/'27e, on a quarterly EBIT base of about SEK 20m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2024's margin was hit by regulatory and R&D costs (ABG note) without a large reaction; costs have never been the deciding line.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: ABG explicitly models the EOGRT cost. Only the timing within quarters is unknown.
findings.independence: ABG Q1 note: 'partly offset by SEK 10m of costs for the ongoing EOGRT study (split between 26e/27e)' https://www.inderes.se/en/third-party-research/i-tech-2026-looking-better-than-feared-abg

outside_window.finding: SCBP vote on the Commission's draft act not to renew medetomidine (Selektope) under the BPR; no vote disclosed as of 2026-10-15, company says Q4 likely; approval runs to 31 Dec 2026; the November 2025 proposal day cost -14.7%, though the EU is about 3% of sales and ABG treats non-renewal as the likely case
CMP (largest customer) Jul-Sep / H1 FY2027 results, the cleanest counterparty read on I-Tech's Q3 volumes, scheduled after the window

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (+0.13) and the +6.3% 5-day run-up lean mildly positive; the evidence is a proxy-level positive on demand and FX offset by a lumpy-order-book risk and an asymmetric reaction function, so it neither confirms nor contradicts the lean, and the scaled number is 0 against a findings sum of 0.0.
language_note: nothing the English sources did not already carry: every I-Tech release goes out simultaneously in Swedish and English with identical content (checked on the 2026-10-15 licence release), and Swedish-language search returned only republished company releases

the MFN Swedish issuer page carried the issuer's own timestamped calendar (Kvartalsrapport 2026-Q3, 2026-10-16 08:00) and a per-release day-reaction column, which is what gave the observed print reactions (-28.5/-12.7/-16.7/+3.2/+5.1%) that the baseline's empty history lacks; MFN is a Swedish platform but the data is language-neutral
the one genuinely non-English input was Japanese, not Swedish: kabutan's CMP headline on the largest customer's +56% Apr-Jun recurring profit
lessons_applied: 'too small about the move' and 'size on the name's own reaction distribution': abs_move_pct raised 8.0 -> 9.0, toward the median absolute print reaction of the six observed reports (~9%), on a $0.1m/day name whose numbers are new

'understatement is the hunters' systematic error': the CMP counterparty finding raised +0.8 -> +1.0 and the order-lumpiness finding -0.7 -> -0.8, sized against a stock that moves ~9% on a sales surprise; both stay capped because the bar is unsourced

'a verified fact is not a predicted reaction' / 'a narrow proxy loses to a broad series': p_up kept at 50, since every directional input is a proxy or inference and the name punishes misses far harder than it rewards beats
